answer_1.quote: traditional model evaluation benchmarks such as GQA, VQA-V2, and TextVQA are characterized by relatively simple questions and answers, with responses often being a single word... the emergence of more powerful MLLMs, traditional evaluation frameworks have become inadequate... a new generation of VQA benchmarks has arisen, such as MMBench, MMVet, and MMMU.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers to visual or multimodal questions
